meta.title: Pizzeria in Amiens, free delivery and open late | Mama La Pizza
meta.description: Mama La Pizza, pizzeria at 15 rue des Otages in Amiens: homemade dough, fresh toppings, Detroit-style pizza. Free delivery, takeaway or dine-in, open until 1 am Thursday to Saturday. Rated 4.7/5 on Google.

items.q: Where do you deliver, and is it really free?
items.a: Yes: delivery is free in Amiens when you order on 03 22 40 33 94. If you're on the outskirts, call us to check your address. On Uber Eats, the platform's own fees apply.
It depends on the time and your address: we'll give you an estimate when you order. On Friday and Saturday nights, allow a little extra.
Until midnight Sunday to Wednesday, and until 1 am Thursday to Saturday. At lunchtime we're open 11:30 am to 2:30 pm, Monday to Saturday.
You pay at the counter or to the delivery driver: there's no online payment on this site. On Uber Eats, you pay in the app.
Our pizzas contain gluten and milk, and some contain egg, fish or seafood. Tell us about your allergy when you order and we'll tell you what's possible.
Yes, for birthdays, offices and parties. Fill in the short "Group orders" form or call us, and we'll have everything ready on time.
